definition.name: FilterControls
definition.description: Render accessible selection and reset controls; parent owns query state and catalog policy.
definition.purpose: Render accessible selection and reset controls; parent owns query state and catalog policy.
definition.requiredData: Accessible label, value/action and parent-supplied applicable state. Domain data remains outside the primitive.
definition.interactions: Keyboard and pointer activation; visible focus; no action on decorative elements; parent owns side effects.
definition.states: Default, focus-visible, hover, active, disabled with explanation; pending/error/success when applicable.
definition.responsive: Keyboard and pointer operable at every width; minimum 44px actions; wrap long Russian labels; no horizontal overflow. Exact geometry and variants require component reference review. No inherited hero layout. 1440×900, 390×844 and 360px verification required.

definition.implementationNotes: Planning candidate only. No production implementation or visual approval. Read exact approved source records and their unresolved policy IDs before implementation. Variants share presentation only; authorization stays in owning domains.
